option_relations.rationale: Cerebral fungal abscess (e.g., invasive aspergillosis) is a broader category that includes cerebral aspergillosis, which is part of the leaf 'Cerebral aspergillosis with lung cancer'.
Cerebral fungal infection (likely cerebral aspergillosis) is a broader category that includes cerebral aspergillosis, which is part of the leaf 'Cerebral aspergillosis with lung cancer'.

Fungal brain abscess secondary to pulmonary infection describes a scenario that aligns with the leaf 'Cerebral aspergillosis with lung cancer', as aspergillosis can originate from pulmonary infection and lead to brain abscess.
The option specifies mucormycosis, while the leaf specifies aspergillosis. These are distinct fungal infections.
